description: The configuration of schema version 3's first drafts: an object with one text for each kind of client. It is now the one text for the client the owner named.

configuration.codex_desktop:
Add this to .codex/config.toml in a folder of its own that you use only for calendar work, which Codex reads for a trusted project, or to ~/.codex/config.toml. The folder is safer.

[mcp_servers.fabric-calendar]
command = "/Applications/Fabric Calendar.app/Contents/MacOS/fabric-mcp-bridge"
args = ["--enrollment", "agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"]
